svg.aria-label: Steady-state tracking. Step input: a type 0 loop leaves a finite error 1 over 1 plus Kp; a type 1 loop has zero error. Ramp input: a type 0 loop falls further and further behind; a type 1 loop follows with a constant gap 1 over Kv
